name: http-request-valid
description: httpRequest parses with a method, headers, an object body, a capture binding, polling and a timeout, and extract accepts a path with a regular expression.
yaml:
- httpRequest:
    method: POST
    url: "http://localhost:8025/api/v1/search?query=to:${email}"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer ${TOKEN}"
    body:
      limit: 5
    as: inbox
    expectStatus: 200
    poll:
      until: $.body.messages[0].Snippet
      interval: 500
    timeout: 30000
- extract:
    from: inbox
    values:
      plain: $.body.id
      otp:
        path: $.body.messages[0].Snippet
        regex: "\\b(\\d{6})\\b"
